description: What a result column DECLARES, compared against the account. Until the live harness learned to read the driver's type metadata it answered VARCHAR for every column, so nothing here could have been written - a type assertion would have passed vacuously or failed for the wrong reason. Each case is a column whose type both engines agree on, parameters included, so the suite is the regression net for the mapping as much as for the engine. A NUMBER keeps its precision and scale; a VARCHAR keeps its length and an unbounded one is the 16MB maximum; BINARY keeps its declared size and BOOLEAN carries none; the datetime family keeps its fractional-second precision and its time-zone bit; the three semi-structured types stay distinct though JDBC hands them all over as strings. Arithmetic keeps the numeric type with the precision and scale the operands imply, a function declares its OWN result type rather than its argument's, a literal carries the width it was written with, and a projected predicate is BOOLEAN. COUNT and the ranking functions are 18-digit counters rather than 38-digit ones; SUM widens the precision by twelve and keeps the scale while AVG adds eighteen and six; MIN, MAX and ANY_VALUE answer one of the VALUES so they carry its type exactly; and grouping changes no declared type. FLOAT is compared by NAME only: no precision or scale is reported for it. Converted 1:1 from query/DeclaredResultTypeTest (now retired). The Java read the declared type off the ResultSet's own column metadata, which the testkit cannot reach; the converted tests wrap each expression in a VIEW and read INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS, the instrument that carries the EXPRESSION's declared type, though it stops a string at the 16777216 a column can declare, as CTAS and DESCRIBE do. Every view column carries an alias, because a view cannot store a derived name.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ty_v AS SELECT n AS a1 FROM ty

SELECT LISTAGG(CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' THEN 'NUMBER(' || NUMERIC_PRECISION || ',' || NUMERIC_SCALE || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('TEXT','VARCHAR') THEN 'VARCHAR(' || CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'BINARY' THEN 'BINARY(' || CHARACTER_OCTET_LENGTH || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'DATE' THEN 'DATE(0,tz=false)' WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('TIME','TIMESTAMP_NTZ') THEN DATA_TYPE || '(' || DATETIME_PRECISION || ',tz=false)' WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('TIMESTAMP_LTZ','TIMESTAMP_TZ') THEN DATA_TYPE || '(' || DATETIME_PRECISION || ',tz=true)' ELSE DATA_TYPE END, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'TY_V'
